full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1, 2 and 8 contested case by filing written statement contending, inter-alia, that the predecessor Safar Ali purchased the entire suit C.S. Plot No. 95 of an area of 1.32 acres including other lands from Bashiruddin and Syeda Banu by registered kabala dated 3rd Falgoon, 1323 B.S. and the same purchased land was recorded in his name in C.S. khatian No. 35 and 36 and while Safar Ali Was possessing the said land he gifted south eastern 52 decimals to the defendant No. 1 executing registered heba-bil-ewaz dated 17th Falgoon, 1356 B.S. who subsequently gifted same to his son defendant No. 8 by executing registered heba-bil-ewaz dated 16.11.1966 A.D. Safar Ali also gifted western 51 decimals of the suit C.S. Plot to his son defendant No. 2 by executing another heba-bil-ewaz dated 18th Agrahayan, 1356 B.S. and also gifted non-disputed 29 decimals of land of the suit C.S. plot to his grand daughter defendant No. 17 by executing registered heba-bil-may, dated 15th Magoon, 1356 B.S. and R.S. khatian No. 36 was prepared in the names of all those donee defendants and they separated the jama by Separation Case Nos. 213 and 424 of 1963-64 and have been possessing their land uninterruptedly without intervention from any quarter and denied plaintiffs claim of title as alleged in the plaint.
